limits: All five jobs completed successfully in the first attempt (no rerun); this artifact audit certifies only the headless current virtualized-list lane (44 checks).

The preceding-host and preceding-SDK controls and the retained onLayout sabotage remain local evidence; this audit only shows that every check they fail passes in the hosted run. Stage-level observations are verified by the independent oracle, not recompared with the local run.
Bundle hashes and the native host hash are declared by the runner; no bundle or native binary is included in the artifact.
CI host hash is not required to equal the local built host.
Mobile and parity jobs are separate: only their PASSED markers are recorded, their outputs are not audited here.
Git-tree verification establishes tracked content at the pushed main checkout; it does not independently inspect a compiled native binary.
The slice's own committed limits are unchanged and still apply:
Godot input injected headless through Input.parse_input_event; real touch hardware, trackpads and Godot Android/iOS exports are not executed.
Animated scrolling is not implemented: a scroll command without animated jumps where RN animates, animated: true throws, and so does scrollToEnd() without arguments.
No momentum or fling: onMomentumScrollBegin/End are accepted but never sent, and drag velocity is 0.
Sticky section headers, RefreshControl/onRefresh, maintainVisibleContentPosition and visible scroll indicators throw when requested.
A wheel step on an inverted list moves the content in the list's own coordinates, as Android's native scroll views do.
Nested lists of the same orientation (measureLayout), initialScrollIndex, numColumns, horizontal RTL, onStartReached, viewAreaCoveragePercentThreshold and minimumViewTime are not certified.
GF-15's 10,000-row fixture with frame and memory results remains open; GF-14 owns the full ScrollView contract.
Every bundle that imports react-native now contains the lazy list getters and RN's StyleSheet module.
Only GF-15's first-slice checkpoint closes; no whole GF, other checkpoint, weight or denominator closes.
